translation.name: Na Rongorongo Uto nina Jesus Christ

content: Abram ma Lot toro tuvavoka
Keri ke, Abram kolua tauna, ma Lot, a dalena hoghona, tara lavighi didira na lei lologho, mara rughuhoru sania Egypt. Mara va sara tana bona mamaha tara holoa nia i Negev.
Abram a sakai na mane lologho, te loghoi subo na lei sheep mana goat mana buluka, kolui na silver mana gold ghua.
Gaira tara sania na bona keri me sakutua me kabu balu na bona inaghona te sara tana lei ghotu lilighina Bethel mi Ai.
Igaa te diki kabu tua, me diki kisua tua na belasukaghi. Me ghoi holohabaa igaa Yahweh.
Ma Lot ghua te loghoi subo na lei sheep mana goat mana buluka, kolui nina binaboli heghena mana lei nina mane lutu.
Me subo na totobo toro sopa loghoi a Abram ma Lot, me mua manana ge kara ghaha kolura vamua ta sakai na bona, na pukuna na pari keri te mua manadira maia didira na lei sopa maumanu.
A didira na mane lutu tara righitaonighi didira maumanu tara hughuhughu [ghua.] Mana bona vaghana keri ghua na kemadira Canaan ma Periz tara ghahara so ilokana na pari keri.
Keri ge bosa Abram vania Lot me ghaghua, “Iroghita eni, a sakai na binaboli vamua. Mara hughuhughu haia tua na lei dida na mane lutu, me mua uto tara ghaghua igaa!
Keri ke, me uto ge koro tuvavoka. Ko vilia na levu ni pari to liona ighoe. Ko kabu tana levu ni pari to vilia, mi nau ku lavia na levu.”

Ma Lot te reikolili, me righia na nanata lilighina na betitina Jordan, te dutuvia Zoar. Na pari eni te betigha vaghaa nina leghai Yahweh i Eden, pe vaghana ghua na pari utoutoa tana butonikomu Egypt. (Tana bona vaghana keri, Yahweh te mua durakera mua na komu i Sodom mi Gomorrah.)
Keri ke, Lot te vilia na nanata udolu lilighina na betitina Jordan, keri ge ke tona palevu iuluna me ke ghanaa igaa. E vaghaa keri toro nea na tuvavoka rana mane raini.
Abram te ghanaa tana butonikomu Canaan, ma Lot te kabu i ghobuni na lei komu sule tana nanata i lilighina i Sodom.
Na vure ni Sodom tara dika ngangata, mara tangohahi haia tana matana Yahweh.
Abram te ghadaru tona i Hebron
Mi murina a Lot te tona sania Abram ka, ge bosa Yahweh vania Abram, “Ko righi utoi na lei bona talighu raini.
Na lei bona ni pari to righighi raini ku hegho ighoe mana lei vaivarimu. Na bona ni pari keri ke nimua haia tua ke vaa me vaa.
Inau ku nera na lei vaivarimu ge kara sepa, ma kara subo vaghara na pughupughu ni pari, te taho tua hei ke idumira!
Ko tona mo ko sakutua kolili mo ko righia heghemu na bona udolu ku hegho eni.”
Keri ka ge sania na bona keri a Abram kolui na lei nina lologho, me va ghanaa ililighina na lei ghai tabu nina Mamre dutuvia Hebron. Igaa Abram te kisua sakai na belasukaghi vania Yahweh.
